name: EVA Precision Industrial Holdings Limited
summary: EVA Precision Industrial Holdings Limited is a Kowloon-based investment holding company founded in 1993 that provides precision manufacturing in China, Vietnam and Mexico. Its office automation equipment and automotive component divisions design and produce metal and plastic molds and components and assemble them into semi-finished goods. It also trades molds and components and develops real estate, serving the office automation, automotive and internet server industries.
